nipa: Nipa at J V.6 read as nīpa.
nipaka: Nipaka (adj.) [cp. BSk. nipaka chief, fr. Sk. nipa, chief, master] 지적인, 영리한, 신중한, 지혜로운 S I.13, 52, 187; M I.339; A I.165 (+jhāyin); III.24, 138; Sn 45÷Dh 328÷DhA I.62; Sn 283, 962, 1038; Nd2 349 (=jātimā) =Nd1 478; Bu I.49; Vbh 426; Miln 34, 342, 411; Vism 3 (defn).
nipakka: Nipakka at Vin I.200 read nippakka.
nipaccākāra: Nipacc--ākāra [nipacca, ger. of nipatati+ākāra] 복종, 겸손, 봉사 S I.178; V.233; A V.66; J I.232; IV.133; VvA 22, 320; PvA 12.
Nipacc--ākāra [nipacca, ger. of nipatati+ākāra] 복종, 겸손, 봉사 S I.178; V.233; A V.66; J I.232; IV.133; VvA 22, 320; PvA 12.
nipaccavādin: Nipacca--vādin (adj.) [nipacca, ger. of nipāteti+vādin] 상처 주는 말을 하는 Sn 217 (=dāyakaṁ nipātetvā appiyavacanāni vattā SnA 272).
Nipacca--vādin (adj.) [nipacca, ger. of nipāteti+vādin] 상처 주는 말을 하는 Sn 217 (=dāyakaṁ nipātetvā appiyavacanāni vattā SnA 272).
nipajjati: Nipajjati [Sk. nipadyate, ni+pajjati] 드러눕다 (자기 위해서) D I.246; A IV.332; J I.150; DhA I.40; PvA 280; aor. nipajji J I.279; II.154; III.83; VvA 75, 76; PvA 74, 75, 93; ger. nipajja J I.7 (V.44: °ṭṭhānacankama). -- Caus. nipajjāpeti 내려두다, 맡기다 J I.50, 253, 267; III.26, 188; DhA I.50; VvA 76 (°etvā rakkhāpetha). Cp. abhi°.
nipatati: Nipatati [Sk. nipatati, ni+patati] 1. (intrs.) 떨어져내리다, 날아내리다, 내려가다, 나가다 Vin II.192 (Bhagavato pādesu sirasā n. 붓다의 발 아래 그의 머리를 굽히다); PvA 60 (id.); J I.278; V.467 (nippatissāmi=nikkhamissāmi Com.) Pv II.89 (v. l. BB parivisayitvā)=nikkhamitvā PvA 109 (cp. nippatati). -- 2. (trs.) 함께 데려오다, 소집하다, in nipatāmase (pres. subj.) "우리 모일까? " J IV.361. See also nipadāmase. -- Cp. abhi°, san°.
nipadāmase: Nipadāmase J III.120 은 오래된, 잘못된 읽기 자료이며 & nipphadāmase로 읽지 않는 한 (=하다, 시작하다, 준비하다, 주다) 주석서 p. 121 의 설명에도 불구하고 nipatāmase 로 정정되어야 한다(=모입시다, 함께 데려옵시다=전념하다): nikārapakārā (=nipaccakārā?) upasaggā (upasajja?) dāmase (dā) ti attho; endorsed by Müller, P.G. p. 97 & Kern, Toev. p. 175. ni+pa+ dāmase 가 될 수는 없다, ni 가 이차적(변경) 동사 구성요소로 쓰이는 경우가 없기 때문이다 (see ni° A 2), & Bdhgh's expln is popular etym. Cp. nipatāmase at J IV.361 (see nipatati).
nipanna: Nipanna (adj.) [pp. of nipajjati] 드러눕는 J I.151, 279; II.103; III.276 (°kāle 그가 자는 동안에), IV.167; PvA 43, 75, 265 (spelt nippanna, opp. nikujja).
nipalāvita: Nipalāvita (pp.) (Com. reading for vipalāvita text) [Sk. viplāvita, see plavati] 헤엄치게 하는, 가라앚은, 물 속에 던진 J I.326.
nipāka: Nipāka (adj.) [Sk. nipāka, ni+pāka (pacati)] 다 자란, 다 발달된, 온 힘을 다해 J VI.327 (of a tree).
nipāta: Nipāta [Sk. nipāta, ni+pāta, of nipatati] 1. 떨어져 내리는 Dh 121 (udabindu°); VvA 279 (diṭṭhi°, a glance); PvA 45 (asa°). -- 2. 하강하는 M I.453. -- 3. 입자, 문법 용어로, 부사, 접속사 & 감탄사를 지칭 J V.243 (assu); PvA 11 (mā), 26 (vo), 40 (taṁ), 50 (ca). -- 4. 책의 부분 (see next). Cp. vi°, san°.
nipātaka: Nipātaka (adj.) [to nipāta] 부분 또는 장으로 나뉜 Dpvs IV.16.
nipātana: Nipātana (nt.) [to nipatati] 1. 습격함 DhA I.295. <-> 2. 잠자러 감 VvA 71 (pacchā° opp. pubbuṭṭhāna). Cp. nipātin.
nipātin: Nipātin (adj.) [to nipatati] 1. 떨어져 내림 또는 날아 내림, 우연히 만남 Dh 35, 36 (yatthakāma° cittaṁ=yattha yattha icchati tattha tatth'eva nipatati DhA I.295). <-> 2. 잠자러 감 D I.60 (pacchā° 늦게 자러 감). <-> Cp. abhi°.
nipāteti: Nipāteti [ni+Caus. of patati] to let fall, throw down into (c. loc.); 몰락을 가져오다, 해치다; 비유적으로, 쳐다보는, 죄를 묻는 D I.91; M I.453 (ayokaṭāhe); J III.359; SnA 272; PvA 152 (bhūmiyaṁ). pp. nipātita 부패한, 악한, 사악한 Vin II.182 (caṇḍa+; text nippātita, v. l. nipphātita).
nipuṇa: Nipuṇa (adj.) [Sk. nipuṇa, dial. for nipṛṇa, to pṛṇoti, pṛ] 영리한, 솜씨좋은, 완성한; 고운, 미세한, 난해한 D I.26÷(n. gambhīra dhamma), 162 (paṇḍita+); M I.487 (dhamma); S I.33; IV.369; A III.78; Sn 1126 (=gambhīra duddasa etc. Nd2 350); Vbh 426; Miln 233, 276; DA I.117; VvA 73 (ariyasaccesu kusala+), 232; PvA 1, 16. Cp. abhinipuṇa.
nippakāra: Nippakāra (adj.) [nis+pakāra 2] 맛이 없는, 맛 없는, 쓸모 없는 J I.340.
nippakka: Nippakka (adj.) [nis+pakka] 끓인, 스며들게 한 Vin I.200.
nippajjati: Nippajjati & Nipphajjati [Sk. niṣpadyate, nis+pajjati] 생산되다, 완수하다, 분출하다, 익다, 결실을 맺다, 발생하다 DhA II.4 (pph); PvA 19 (=upakappati), 71 (phalaṁ ijjhati n.), 120 (id.). pp. nipphanna. See also nipphādeti & nipphatti etc.; cp. also abhi°.
nipphajjati: Nippajjati & Nipphajjati [Sk. niṣpadyate, nis+pajjati] 생산되다, 완수하다, 분출하다, 익다, 결실을 맺다, 발생하다 DhA II.4 (pph); PvA 19 (=upakappati), 71 (phalaṁ ijjhati n.), 120 (id.). pp. nipphanna. See also nipphādeti & nipphatti etc.; cp. also abhi°.
nippatati: Nippatati & Nipphatati [nis+patati] 떨어져 나가다; 튀어 나가다, 나타나다, ~로부터 나가다 (c. abl.) Vin II.151 (nipphaṭati, v. l. nippaṭati); J V.467 (=nikkhamati Com.; or is it nipatati?). -- ger. nippacca (cp. BSk. nirpatya AvŚ I.209).
nipphatati: Nippatati & Nipphatati [nis+patati] 떨어져 나가다; 튀어 나가다, 나타나다, ~로부터 나가다 (c. abl.) Vin II.151 (nipphaṭati, v. l. nippaṭati); J V.467 (=nikkhamati Com.; or is it nipatati?). -- ger. nippacca (cp. BSk. nirpatya AvŚ I.209).
nippatta: Nippatta (adj.) [nis+patta] 1. 날개 없는, 털 뽑힌 (새) Vin IV.259. -- 2. without leaves J III.496 (=patita--patta); SnA 117 (°puppha). -- Note nippatta at Dhs 1035 is to be read as nibbatta.
nippadā: Nippadā (?) at S I.225 read nipphādā (q. v.).
nippadesa: Nippadesa [Sk. *niṣpradesa, nis+padesa] only in instr. & abl.=따로따로 DhsA 2, 30, 37, 297.
nippapañca: Nippapañca (adj.) [nis+papañca] 발산하지 않는 S IV.370; Dh 254 (Tathāgata); °ārāma 미루기를 좋아하지 않는 M I.65 (Neumann trsl. I.119: "dem keine Sonderheit behagt"); A III.431; IV.229 sq.; Miln 262.
nippabha: Nippabha (adj.) [nis+prabhā] 광채 없는 J II.415; Miln 102.
nippariyāya: Nippariyāya [nis+pariyāya] 1. 구별 또는 차이 없는, 설명 또는 입증 없는 DhsA 317 (°ena 비유적이 아닌), 403 (°desanā); VvA 320. -- 2. 변함 없는, 되돌리지 않는 Miln 113, 123, 212.
nippalāpa: Nippalāpa (adj.) [nis+palāpa] 지껄임 또는 말 없는, 말하지 않는 A II.183 (apalāpa+; v. l. °palāsa).
nippalibodha: Nippalibodha (adj.) [nis+palibodha] 장애 없는, 방해하지 않는 Miln 11.
nippitika: Nippitika (adj.) [Sk. *niṣpaitṛka=아비 없는 또는 *niṣprītika?] 사생아 J I.133 (v. l. nippītika q. v.).
nippipāsa: Nippipāsa (adj.) [nis+pipāsā] 갈증 또는 욕망 없는 Sn 56; Nd2 351.
nippītika: Nippītika (adj.) [nis+pīti+ka] 1. 쾌락 (의 느낌) 없는 (세 번째 jhāna의 특징, q. v.) D I.75; A I.81. -- 2. 사람받지 못한, 수양자녀 etc. (?) see nippitika.
nippīḷana: Nippīḷana (nt.) [nis+pīḷana] 쥐어짜는, 억누르는; 주먹질 J III.160. Cp. abhinippīḷanā.
nippīḷeti: Nippīḷeti [nis+pīḷeti] 쥐어짜다, 누르다, 꽉 쥐다, 독촉하다 J I.63, 223. Pass. nippīḷiyati, only in ppr. nippīḷiyamāna 독촉받아 Vin II.303; VvA 138; PvA 31, 192. Cp. abhi°.
nippurisa: Nippurisa (adj.) [nis+purisa] 1. 사람들 없는 PvA 177. <-> 2. 사람들 없는, 여성들(여성 devas) 만으로 실행한 (of turiyā=여성 악단) Vin I.15; D II.21; J V.506. Cp. M Vastu III.165 (niṣpuruṣena nāṭakena) & AvŚ I.321 (niṣpuruṣena tūryeṇa; see also note in Index p. 229), whereas Divy 3 (see Index) has niṣparuṣa (soft), with v. l. niṣpuruṣa.
nippesika: Nippesika [cp. Sk. niṣpeṣa clashing against, bounce, shock, niṣ+piṣ] 마술을 행하는 사람, 마술사 D I.8 (=nippeso sīlaṁ etesan ti DA.I.91); A III.111.
nippesikatā: Nippesikatā (f.) [abstr. fr. prec.] 마술, 눈속임 (cp. Kern, Toev. p. 176) Vbh 353 (expld at Vism 29); Miln 383.
nippothana: Nippothana (nt.) [nis+pothana of puth to crush] 으깸, 때림, 파괴함 SnA 390.
nipphajjana: Nipphajjana (nt.) (or °nā f. ?) [n. abstr. fr. nipp(h)ajjati] 결과, 절차, 달성, 계획 J IV.83.
nipphatti: Nipphatti (f.) [cp. Sk. niṣpatti] 결과, 완수, 효과, 목적, 완성, 완벽 J I.56, 335 (of dreams), 343, 456; IV.137 (sippe); VI.36; VvA 138 (sippa°); DhA II.6 (중요성, 의미, 흘끝 봄); DhsA 354; PvA 122, 282 (sippe); Nett 54. Cp. abhi°.
nipphattika: Nipphattika (adj.) [fr. nipphatti] 결실이 있는 J III.166 (evaṁ?‹ 그런 결과).
nipphanna: Nipphanna (adj.) [pp. of nippajjati] 완수한, 완벽한, 훈련한 S I.215 (°sobhin, spelt nippanna); J IV.39 (°sippa 기술의 숙련자, M.A.); DhA III.285 (sasse); DhsA 316; 철학에서, 결정된, 조건지어진 Kvu XI.7; XXIII.5; Vism 450; Pts. Of Controversy, 395. Cp. abhi°, pari°. See also Cpd. 156, 157.
nipphala: Nipphala (adj.) [nis+phala] 결실 없는, 열매를 맺지 못한, a° 결실이 없지 않은, 즉, 충분히 보상 받은 (dāyaka, 좋은 선물을 주는 사람) Pv I.42; 55, PvA 194; Sdhp 504.
nipphalita: Nipphalita (adj.) [Sk. niṣphārita, pp. of nipphaleti, nis+ phaleti] 깨뜨린, 쪼개어 연 J I.493 (lasī=nikkhantā Com.; v. l. nipphaḷita).
nipphāṇitatta: Nipphāṇitatta (nt.) [nis+phāṇita+tva] 설탕 또는 당밀 없는 상태 또는 J III.409.
nipphādaka: Nipphādaka (adj.) [fr. nipphādeti] 생산하는, 완수하는 DhsA 47; PvA 147 (sukha --°ṁ puññaṁ).
nipphādana: Nipphādana (nt.) [Sk. niṣpādana, to nipphādeti] 완수 Miln 356; DA I.195.
nipphādar: Nipphādar [n. ag.=Sk. niṣpādayitṛ cp. nipphāditar] 생산하는 또는 얻는 사람 S I.225 (atthassa; read nipphādā, nom. For nippadā).
nipphādita: Nipphādita [pp. of nipphādeti] 생산된, 생산하는 (perhaps=nipphāditar) VvA 113.
nipphāditar: Nipphāditar [n. ag. to nipphādeti, cp. nipphādar] 생산하는 또는 완수하는 사람 PvA 8 (read "so nipphāditā" for sā nipphādikā). Cp. nipphādita and nipphādaka.
nipphādeti: Nipphādeti [Caus. of nippajjati] 가지고 나오다, 생산하다; 완수하다, 실행하다 J I.185 (lābhasakkāraṁ); V.81; Miln 299; VvA 32, 72 (grd. nipphādetabba, n. of ablative case); Sdhp 319, 426. -- pp. nipphādita. Cp. abhinipphādeti.
nipphoṭana: Nipphoṭana (nt.) [nis+pothanā] 때림 S IV.300 (v. l. ṭh.). Cp. nippothana.
nipphoṭeti: Nipphoṭeti [nis+potheti] 때려 눕히다, 질식시키다, 으깨다 S I.101, 102.
